attributes.name: Title
attributes.value: Single-cell RNA-seq of of bone marrow derived mononuclear phagocytes derived from mouse; rat; rabbit or pig

attributes.name: Study type
attributes.value: RNA-seq of coding RNA from single cells

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Bone marrow derived phagocytes from mouse, rat, rabbit and pig stimulated with LPS (100ng/mL) or with dsRNA (poly I:C)  (1ug/mL) for 0,2,4,6 hours.  Processed files include UMI matrices of QCed cells that belong to the first cluster (as described in the publication), which were used for all the analyses presented in the  publication.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Cells were washed with PBS and then detached using a non-enzymatic solution.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Cells were directly processed in a 10X Chromium machine (10X Genomics) according to the manufacturer’s protocol (version V2).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: The Single Cell Gel Bead kit (#120217), Single cell chip kit (#120219) and Single cell library kit (#120218) were used along with 10x GemCode Single Cell Instrument as per manufacturer specifications and manuals (Document # CG00011; Revision B).

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Samples were sequenced on an Illumina HiSeq 4000 instrument (one sample per lane)

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: Cells were stimulated with either 100ng/mL lipopolysaccharide (LPS) (Invivogen, Cat. Code: tlrl-smlps) or with 1ug/mL of  High-Molecular Weight poly I:C (Invivogen, Cat. Code: tlrl-pic), transfected with 2uL/mL Lipofectamin 2,000, for 2/4/6 hours before collection.

attributes.name: Description
attributes.value: The count matrices are the output (filtered matrix files) of the quantification preformed on the microfluidic droplet cell capture data using 10X Genomics’ Cell Ranger Single-Cell Software Suite (version 2.0, 10x Genomics Inc) against the relevant genome (ENSEMBL version 84, mouse, rat, rabbit and pig).
